title: reading first: an object definition whose embedded listViews name a field withheld by a disabled package — does the object save door refuse it or store it (follow-up of #34901)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (mailbox #32588, 6963320315), from the seat's L2 on PR #34979 (6963280774). That review found #34901's failure class live on other surfaces: a view or definition naming a field that a disabled package withholds. The review read code and ran nothing on these, so this card is **reading first**.

Follow-up of #34901 (p1; HotCRM's next release waits on it). The view-type bindings are already #34989.

## Question
An object definition whose embedded `listViews` name a withheld field: while the package is off, does the object save door refuse it, or store it? And what does the stored view do when it is opened?

Done when a live reading (a package P extends an object with a field, a definition in Q names that field, P disabled) answers the question, and the fix is made or filed with its own grade.

Grade: **p2 · domain:server**. Theme: HotCRM usable (the #34901 class). The outcome is not yet known, so p2 until the reading shows a user-facing failure.
